Name: Core Passive: Day Break

Descriptions: The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10.6%</color>, and when Harumasa's <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Gleaming Edge</color>, for up to a maximum of 3 stacks per use of the skill and stacking up to 6 times, lasting 5s, repeated triggers reset the duration. Cons.Name: "High Spirit"
Cons.Effect: The maximum stack limit of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya</color> increases to 14 stacks. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quiver</color> is triggered, 2 consecutive <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will be fired at the target.

Cons.Name: Languish
Cons.Effect: When using an <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Harumasa gains 7 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color>, up to a max of 7 stacks. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color>, the DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> increases by 50%. Consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color> once <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> ends.

Cons.Name: Occasionally Motivated
Cons.Effect: <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> now lasts for 20s. When <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> hits enemies, Harumasa gains 30 Decibels once per use of this skill. Upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, apply the maximum stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> to all on-field enemies.

Cons.Name: Tacit Understanding
Cons.Effect: After <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalies, Harumasa will ignore 15% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color> for 12s. Every 12 times an enemy is hit by <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color>, trigger an extra electromagnetic explosion, dealing 1,500% of Harumasa's ATK to the target as <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
